senses.gloss:
चिर चिर (i. e. probably चर् + अ, cf. चरम),
 I. adj., f. रा.
 1. Long, Hariv. 9942.
 2. Olden, Bhāg. P. 3, 2, 21.
 II. n. Delay, Rām. 4, 5, 27.
 III. The acc. रम्, instr. रेण, dat. राय, abl. रात्, gen. रस्य, and loc. रे, are used adverbially: रम्, A long time. Man. 4, 60. रेण, After a long time, Sāv. 5, 84; from a long time back, Prab. 29, 14. राय, A long time, Ragh. 14, 59; after a long time, at last, Pañc. 231, 21; too late, MBh. 5, 780; for a long time, MBh. 13, 392. रात्, After a long time, Pañc. ii. d. 63; at last, Rām. 4, 27, 17; from a long time back, Hit. 17, 14. रस्य, After a long time, at last, Rām. 2, 54, 20.
 --When former part of a comp. word these adverbs drop their terminations, and appear in the form of the base चिर, e. g. Rām. 1, 42, 1.
 --Comp.

चीर चीर (perhaps a syncope of चीवर), n.
 1. Bark, Rām. 5, 31, 22; a vesture of bark, Man. 6, 6.
 2. A rag, Kathās. 4, 48; also fem. रा, Rājat. 4, 573.
 3. A cloth, Rām. 2, 37, 10 (कुश-, A cloth of Kuśa grass).
चिरकार चिर-कार, चिरकारि चिरकारि, i. e. चिर-कृ + इ, चिरकारिक चिरकारिक, i. e. चिरकार + इक, and चिरकारिन् चिर-कारिन्, adj. Slow, tardy, MBh. 12, 9482; 9539; 9483; 9485.
चिरकारिता चिरकारिता, and चिरकारित्व चिरकारित्व, i. e. चिर-कारिन् + ता, f., or त्व, n. Slowness, MBh. 12, 9524; 9489.
चिरकालत्व चिर-काल + त्व, n. A long interval, Pañc. 115, 18.

चिरंतन चिरंतन, i. e. चिर + म् + तन, adj.
 1. Old, Pañc. 228, 11.
 2. Hereditary, Pañc. 16, 1.
चिरय चिरय (a denominative derived from चिर by अय), Par. To tarry, Pañc. 52, 12.
चिराय चिराय (a denomin. derived from चिर by य), Par., Ātm. To tarry, Pañc. 257, 1.
† चिरि चिरि, ii. 5, चिरिणु, Par. To hurt.
चीरी चीरी (based on an imitative sound; cf. the next), f. A cricket, Yājñ. 3, 215.
चिर्भटिका चिर्भटिका, i. e. चिर्भटी + क, and चिर्भटी चिर्भटी, f. A kind of cucumber, Cucumis utilissimus utilissimus, Pañc. 30, 7; 248, 12.
चीरिन् चीरिन्, i. e. चीर + इन्, adj. Covered with bark or rags, MBh. 3, 1002.
चीरीवाक चीरीवाक, i. e. चीरी-वच् + अ, m. A cricket, Man. 12, 63.
चीर्ण चीर्ण, ptcple. of the pf. pass. of चर्, q. cf.
चिर- + जात चिर- + जात, adj. old, MBh. 3, 13334.

चीर- + वासस् चीर- + वासस्,
 I. adj. 1. covered with a cloth made of bark, Man. 11, 101. 2. covered with rags, Bhāg. P. 1, 15, 43.
चीर-वल्कल- + वासस् चीर-वल्कल- + वासस्, adj. covered with a cloth made of bark, Rām. 3, 55, 15.
चिर- + विल्व चिर- + विल्व, m. a tree, Pongamia glabra Vent., Rām. 3, 79, 34.
